ticker: Six killed as cyclone hits India's eastern coast
Russian drone attack kills 13 in Ukraine's Dnipro
Indian shares rally after Fed holds rates steady
Oracle opens cloud infrastructure to Google's AI chips
Supreme Court criticizes ministry over tribunal autonomy

articles.headline: Six Killed in Cyclone Off India's Eastern Coast
articles.brief: A powerful cyclone off India's eastern coast has resulted in six deaths, triggering severe weather conditions, heavy rainfall, and widespread disruptions across coastal regions and neighboring states.

articles.headline: Russian Drone Attack on Train Station Kills 13
articles.brief: A deadly Russian drone strike targeting a railway station in Ukraine's Dnipro region has killed 13 people, escalating tensions and drawing swift international condemnation amid ongoing conflict.

articles.headline: Oracle Opens Cloud Platform to Google AI Chips
articles.brief: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure announced plans to offer Google’s custom AI Tensor Processing Units starting in 2027, introducing new enterprise competition to traditional GPU market dominance.

articles.headline: Chinese AI Model Executes Complex Cyberattacks in Tests
articles.brief: Researchers report that a Chinese artificial intelligence model successfully carried out sophisticated, multi-step cyberattacks during controlled testing environments, raising cybersecurity concerns.

articles.headline: Indian Shares Rise Following Federal Reserve Rate Decision
articles.brief: Indian equity markets advanced after the US Federal Reserve kept interest rates steady, supported by positive corporate earnings updates that boosted investor sentiment across sectors.

articles.headline: Shell and Total Energies Post High Quarterly Profits
articles.brief: Energy giants Shell and TotalEnergies reported their highest quarterly profits since 2022, largely driven by strong refining margins and steady operational income across global markets.

articles.headline: Supreme Court Rebukes Corporate Affairs Ministry Over NCLT Autonomy
articles.brief: The Supreme Court strongly criticized the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, warning that growing executive control threatens the institutional independence of company law tribunals.

articles.headline: BJP Wins Majority in MLC Polls While Opposition Holds Ground
articles.brief: The BJP-led NDA secured major victories in legislative council elections across four states, though Congress and Samajwadi Party held key symbolic constituencies in Nagpur and Varanasi.

articles.headline: Karnataka Hikes Milk Prices Amid Farmer Strains
articles.brief: The Karnataka government has approved an eight-rupee per litre increase in milk prices, directly passing a significant portion of the hike to drought-struggling farmers starting November 1.

articles.headline: IndiGo CEO Signals Potential Airfare Hikes Amid Soaring Fuel Costs
articles.brief: IndiGo leadership warned that airlines may have no choice but to raise ticket prices as jet fuel costs surge significantly compared to the previous year, impacting operating margins.

articles.headline: Elena Rybakina Secures Year-End World No. 1 Ranking
articles.brief: Tennis star Elena Rybakina officially clinched the year-end world number one ranking for the first time following a dominant season featuring multiple Grand Slam victories.

articles.headline: Mumbai Indians Part Ways with Lasith Malinga and Coaching Staff
articles.brief: Indian Premier League franchise Mumbai Indians announced a major overhaul of their coaching setup, parting ways with bowling legend Lasith Malinga and other key coaches ahead of the season.

articles.headline: Supreme Court Seeks Compensation Framework for Digital Fraud Victims
articles.brief: The Supreme Court has called for robust compensation guidelines to protect digital fraud victims, holding banks accountable if institutions fail to maintain adequate due diligence.

articles.headline: ISRO Prepares to Launch NVS-03 Navigation Satellite
articles.brief: The Indian Space Research Organisation is scheduled to launch the NVS-03 navigation satellite aboard a GSLV rocket to enhance regional navigation capabilities and test an indigenous atomic clock.
